title: Project Vaporize CLI families from project Pkl
description: Give Vaporize a project-level Pkl declaration for ordinary and Digi CLI variants, then project canonical debug and release executable identities without coupling the model to Xcode or platform conditionals.
acceptanceCriteria: The Vaporize project Pkl schema declares tool families, owners, and cli, stui, tui, or sd variants.
A pure Swift planner projects debug names with the temporal source coordinate immediately before @ and release names without that coordinate.
The planner validates abbreviated language and collective ownership conventions and rejects ambiguous debug or release inputs.
The materialization record hard-codes the would-be schema-universal family as the VaporizeToolMaterializationPlan receptor carrying a temporal version, with no schemaVersion or kind field.
The Vaporize CLI exposes plan-tool-family and emits its human or JSON plan through CommonLog without a new print path.
Windows tests evaluate a real Pkl fixture and prove debug, release, and refusal behavior.

evidence.tests: swift test --scratch-path C:\b\v\vaporize-tool-family --filter VaporizeProjectModelTests: 3 tests passed
evidence.boundary: This slice plans canonical identities; build, rename, and installation materialization remain separate follow-on work.

resolution: Added declarative Pkl tool families, a cross-platform Swift projection model, CommonLog-backed CLI planning, and Windows proof.
